authoring_stage: before new runtime implementation review or predictions
denominator: Separate mutation/control obligations; never added to the 24 authored language cases.
execution_contract: Use a valid positive certificate obtained after freeze; change one boundary at a time, recompute public content hashes where appropriate, and retain original and mutated bytes. Receipt self-hashes and status labels must not grant authority. Test the independent validator separately from runtime replay.

checks.mutation: Apply a context-name receipt to a different occurrence or a different lexical reading with the same letter skeleton.
checks.expected: Reject detached evidence; exact lexical identity, source segment and occurrence must match.

checks.mutation: Use the unvocalized-name bridge when the declared name contains an explicit contrary internal vowel or shadda.
checks.expected: Reject this bridge; do not erase the supplied distinction.

checks.mutation: Provide a plausible context name but remove the independent learned inflected noun evidence.
checks.expected: Do not infer shadda, nominal class or a licensed reading from context alone.

checks.mutation: Keep one of two identical unvocalized context names and discard the other to obtain a unique referent.
checks.expected: Reject uniqueness; retain all compatible identity candidates.

checks.mutation: Omit number on a nominal source record and set its output number to singular with no independent source-backed derivation.
checks.expected: Reject unsupported inference; F/M or missing S is not itself the stated derivation.

checks.mutation: Transport N/ADJ case evidence and also copy POS, gender, number or sense from the donor reading.
checks.expected: Reject the additional transport unless each field has its own independent licensed derivation.

checks.mutation: Borrow an adjective agreement edge from the object, a different conjunct, or a relative clause inner predicate.
checks.expected: Reject; the same claim subject and predicate must own the witness.

checks.mutation: Drop an incomplete or semantically disagreeing viable alternative to turn DEFER into consensus.
checks.expected: Reject; all viable interpretations and complete signed receipt sets must survive.

checks.mutation: Change a nisba tamyiz owner from the object in T03 to its actor while retaining both argument identities.
checks.expected: Reject; membership in claim.args alone is insufficient proof of ownership.

checks.mutation: Move T06 water or self qualifier to the other clause, or take its owner reference from that other clause.
checks.expected: Reject; claim, governor, dependent and reference must be linked in one analysis.

checks.mutation: Replace a retained tamyiz qualification by an ordinary direct-object argument while preserving the verb lemma.
Activate tamyiz for the definite or nominative counterexample after ignoring its article or ending.
checks.expected: Reject under the declared ordinary nisba-tamyiz scope.

checks.control: A temporal accusative following a compatible event, such as صباحا with independently supplied temporal evidence, is not licensed as tamyiz merely by being a noun in the accusative.
checks.expected: Require independent temporal-versus-tamyiz frame evidence; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than selecting the desired label.
checks.scope: Control recipe, not an uncounted fixed-status language case.

checks.mutation: Copy the object suffix 3MS profile into the first-person host in P04/P05.
Create a bare-host certificate from a connected token but omit or overlap its object suffix span.
checks.expected: Reject source nonconservation and missing complete host evidence.

checks.mutation: Reuse P04 source/answer proof against P05 speaker context.
checks.expected: Reject changed-context replay; a correct answer for one speaker is not evidence for the other.

checks.mutation: Assert the command content of P06 as a completed past event.
Resolve P02 by selecting the nearest prior masculine singular referent or P03 by picking an unmentioned context entity.
